machines.name: Direct hook proof capture and media settlement
machines.state_storage: Temporary fixture files and imported-code side record; committed proof JSON/media; per-run in-memory observations
machines.state_notation: Analytical phases of a build-time state owner or parser, not execution authority and not installed-host qualification.

transitions.guard: Capture-owned temporary root
transitions.effects: Create temporary project/home/tmp and allowlisted environment; initialize Git and fixed fixture identity.
transitions.failure_retry: Cleanup validates owned root prefix/parent; no current user project is exercised.

transitions.guard: Synthetic PreToolUse payload for git add -A
transitions.effects: Run actual Python entry; record status, stderr, index/worktree observations and gate log.
transitions.failure_retry: The requested git add command itself is never executed; direct replay cannot prove host discovery.

transitions.guard: Exit2 with H-03, unchanged staged list, note remains untracked and actual block event
transitions.effects: Build record with actual entry-source raw SHA256 and hostDiscoveryProven=false.
transitions.failure_retry: Any failed behavioral assertion stops capture; captured imports are known by harness but are not all persisted in this proof schema.

transitions.guard: Normalize timestamps/paths and omit capturedAt; same evidence and no force
transitions.effects: Keep prior JSON/media and report unchanged.
transitions.failure_retry: A matching record alone does not read back each media asset; force requests fresh rendering.

transitions.guard: Validated replay and owned frame root
transitions.effects: Write frames, MP4, WebM and poster.
transitions.failure_retry: Renderer failure leaves the prior proof JSON in place; a later run can retry because new record has not been committed.

transitions.guard: All requested media rendering returned
transitions.effects: Write hook-proof.json last and report exact capture identity.
transitions.failure_retry: This is ordered multi-file output, not one atomic media-plus-record transaction.

transitions.guard: Owned temporary scope
transitions.effects: Dispose fixture, then remove frame directory even if fixture disposal throws.
transitions.failure_retry: Cleanup failure is not reclassified as successful fixture destruction.

machines.name: Documentation examples: capture, pin, validate and render
machines.state_storage: Pinned example files, per-run fixtures, immutable in-memory projection and generated Markdown AST
machines.state_notation: Analytical phases of a build-time state owner or parser, not execution authority and not installed-host qualification.

transitions.guard: Actual helper modules and local Git fixture
transitions.effects: Observe initial/repeated injection, source change, unmapped/self-read and budget behavior; record actual file hashes.
transitions.failure_retry: Historical SOURCE_REVISION is separately labeled; no live host or approval claim.

transitions.guard: Explicit selected capture mode
transitions.effects: Check exact JSON equality, intentionally replace teaching capture, or print it.
transitions.failure_retry: Mismatch exits1; an older observation is not silently called current.

transitions.guard: Every dependency byte equals pinned historical Git source
transitions.effects: Hash actual entry before execution and imported files afterward; use isolated home and mocked project/usage inputs.
transitions.failure_retry: No account, billing or installed-host evidence follows from this renderer fixture.

transitions.guard: Deterministic input, no fixture ledger writes
transitions.effects: Require expected segments, hash ANSI output and write exact theme inventory.
transitions.failure_retry: Missing pin/object, changed dependency or failed assertion stops generation.

transitions.guard: Exact reviewed engine digest
transitions.effects: Create draft spec/plan in temporary repo; require structural/ready success, approval refusal and dispatch refusal.
transitions.failure_retry: No approval is manufactured. Failure stops before a complete provenance record is emitted.

transitions.event: Run fixed RED and GREEN tests
transitions.guard: Correct exit codes, test count, no ERROR
transitions.effects: Write observed test results and copy fixed sources; write file inventory/provenance last.
transitions.failure_retry: An interruption can leave partial output; build-time consumer must verify full pinned membership/digests.

transitions.guard: Exact file inventory/hashes, inert model tag, draft/no approvals/PENDING tasks, bound native results and expected RED/GREEN
transitions.effects: Project criteria/tasks/results without executing HTML.
transitions.failure_retry: Malformed evidence fails build; validation is a fixed fixture contract, not general native validation.

transitions.guard: Safe id, existing matching record, authored fence empty
transitions.effects: Inject captured output and entry-hash label.
transitions.failure_retry: Unknown capture, wrong id or prefilled fence fails build instead of merging invented output.

machines.name: Documentation release and proof applicability derivation
machines.state_storage: Build-time tag inventory, original receipt ledger, historical source snapshots and generated site JSON
machines.state_notation: Analytical phases of a build-time state owner or parser, not execution authority and not installed-host qualification.

transitions.guard: Bounded target block; required targets/manifests; exact duplicate-free ledger schema
transitions.effects: Collect per-target tag prefixes and original-publication receipts.
transitions.failure_retry: Malformed target/version/SHA/receipt refuses build.

transitions.guard: Highest stable SemVer tag in local inventory for each target
transitions.effects: Name selected commit publicationCommit; mark original receipt recorded/not-recorded independently.
transitions.failure_retry: There is no GitHub Release status input. Tag-only and draft-release tags are not distinguished from published releases here.

transitions.event: Read historical manifests and Pi contract
transitions.guard: Exact selected commit; manifest versions equal tag; exact AST Set declaration
transitions.effects: Read historical payload manifests and supported Pi versions at the selected tag.
transitions.failure_retry: Historical reads cannot by themselves establish that a GitHub Release or package was distributed.

transitions.guard: Exact HEAD; Actions SHA equals HEAD when GITHUB_ACTIONS=true
transitions.effects: Local mode observes dirty worktree; Actions mode returns dirty=false after SHA check.
transitions.failure_retry: Actions branch does not independently call isDirty; equality of HEAD and GITHUB_SHA alone does not attest a clean working tree.

transitions.guard: Exact pre-bash source path, direct replay type and hostDiscoveryProven=false
transitions.effects: Compare only the replay entry-file raw digest with current and selected-tag entry bytes.
transitions.failure_retry: This is entry-source applicability, not imported-dependency equivalence or host registration proof.

transitions.guard: Complete identity and applicability object
transitions.effects: Write record; static endpoint serializes it; display checks applicable equals both match flags.
transitions.failure_retry: Inconsistent display input throws. A successful JSON projection does not add publication evidence absent from its inputs.

machines.name: Version-fact extraction, process cache and token resolution
machines.state_storage: One module-level VersionFacts cache plus build-time content AST
machines.state_notation: Analytical phases of a build-time state owner or parser, not execution authority and not installed-host qualification.

transitions.guard: Repository root found by required sentinels
transitions.effects: Read owner sources/manifests and require exactly one matching declaration; compare Node declared/enforced floor and Codex minimum/CI floor.
transitions.failure_retry: Ambiguous, malformed or disagreeing declarations throw; no remembered version fallback.

transitions.guard: Missing file ENOENT versus another failure
transitions.effects: If absent, leave release/pi-supported facts unknown; if present parse required host rows and supported versions.
transitions.failure_retry: Unreadable or malformed present record is not treated as absent.

transitions.guard: Successful complete load
transitions.effects: Reuse one fact map for subsequent calls in the process.
transitions.failure_retry: A later file change is not observed until a new process or uncached owner path; cache lifetime is part of the build contract.

transitions.guard: Own property exists and token grammar complete
transitions.effects: Replace tokens in prose, code, HTML and selected frontmatter fields.
transitions.failure_retry: Unknown token or malformed residue fails instead of publishing a literal or guessed version.

machines.name: Historical atlas source binding and generated projection

machines.state_notation: Analytical phases of a build-time state owner or parser, not execution authority and not installed-host qualification.

transitions.guard: Exact selected blob or pinned historical commit; safe real source paths

transitions.failure_retry: Missing objects or drift stops build. Only root changelog may gain notes above intact reviewed history under its explicit rule.

transitions.guard: Literal whole-file SKILL_ENTRY may redirect once
transitions.effects: Read description from exact command/skill source; project host exclusions and form.
transitions.failure_retry: No recursive template/filename guessing; malformed or multiline unsupported description rejects.

transitions.guard: Registry plus explicitly retired routes equals historical catalog; lens roster unchanged
transitions.effects: Hide invocations for retired routes, use pinned historical metadata for them; project selected-work labels and attach source-update boundary.
transitions.failure_retry: An unchanged shape is not proof of current release/host behavior; retired commands remain historical boxes.

transitions.guard: Safe noncyclic named site design tokens
transitions.effects: Resolve one CSS token source; escape authored labels and generate SVG/HTML/reading views.

transitions.guard: Browser transpilation succeeds

transitions.guard: Known pages/lessons, nonempty nonduplicate lists, every lesson mapped

transitions.failure_retry: Unknown/unmapped membership throws with explicit problems.

transitions.guard: Root-absolute unprefixed local links; unwrapped eligible table
transitions.effects: Prefix base idempotently; wrap tables and add row labels only to unambiguous authored-guide tables.
transitions.failure_retry: Complex tables retain scrolling form; no invented column association.

transitions.guard: Validated graph and safe labels/namespaces
transitions.effects: Render the explicit teaching graph, then sequentially write declared assets.

transitions.guard: Required root marker/title/description, font/color inventory and measured label bounds

findings.status: source-confirmed and pure source-function probe; no actual unpublished production tag alleged
findings.title: Documentation derives published-release state from tag presence alone
findings.detail: selectCurrentGovernanceReleases chooses the highest stable local tag, accepts an empty original-publication receipt ledger, and labels its commit publicationCommit. Historical manifest equality and Pi-source parsing validate content identity but do not observe GitHub Release draft/published status. The publication workflow can create a tag before publishing. Therefore tag-only/draft and published states collapse at this site boundary.
findings.probe: probe-site-publication-result.json: synthetic stable tags and zero receipts are selected; no GitHub/network operation was performed.
findings.recommendation: Feed a durable observed non-draft publication record into site selection, keyed to immutable tag and payload identity. If that observation is unavailable, label a tag as a tag and leave publication unknown. Do not restore a stale receipt ledger as a blanket new-release gate.
